{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of species
species_counts = df['species'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of flipper length by species
flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print results
missing_values, duplicates, species_counts, flipper_by_species"}
